subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Count forwards and backwards in 1s from any number between 1 and 10 (weeks 1-4) and between 1 and 20 (weeks 5-10); describe the sequence

show.line: Let's count to ten! One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.

rounds.prompt: Count on with me. Four, five, six. What comes next?
What comes next? Three, four, five, and then?
Count the frogs on the log. How many?
Now count backwards. Seven, six, five, and then?
Start at seven and count up to ten. Go!

hints: Say the numbers slowly. Each number is one more.
Backwards means getting smaller. Ten, nine, eight.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count backwards from five.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I forgot three. Five, four, three, two, one.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count back together. Five, four, three, two, one!

parent_line: Can count forwards and backwards between 1 and 10 from any number.
